notes: Fixed: stops ahead missing on some routes (an empty answer from the stops server was kept for good). They come back at the next sync.
Fixed: importing a GPX with no points no longer replaces your route of the same name.
Faster sync for a new route: stops first, BMKG warnings after, and busy servers are left sooner.

messages.title: Welcome to Cyclone Lite
messages.text: Thanks for riding with Cyclone Lite! To get started: download the map for your area (Options → Offline maps; pick the smallest that covers where you ride), and turn off battery optimisation for Cyclone Lite (Options → This phone) so rides record smoothly with the screen off. New versions show up here as a notification. Found a bug? Options → Beta & updates → Send problem report. Ride safe!

messages.title: New in Lite 0.15: ride insights
messages.text: After each ride, the summary now tells you how it went in plain words: new personal bests, how it compares with your other rides, pacing, the wind and heat on the day, and with a heart-rate sensor or power meter, how hard it was and how to recover. Update, then open any ride in History to see it. Tell us what you think: Options → Beta & updates → Report on GitHub.

messages.title: Lite 0.15.2: stops ahead on every route
messages.text: On some routes, including ones made in Google Maps, the Ahead page never showed stops, however often you synced: one empty answer from the OpenStreetMap stops server was kept for good. Cyclone Lite 0.15.2 fixes it, and those routes get their stops at the next sync (or tap Online → Sync now). Syncing a new route is quicker too: stops come first, and a busy server is left sooner. And a GPX file with no points no longer replaces your route of the same name. To update: Options → Beta & updates → Check & update.
